role_and_message.evidence: The M optical concept remains two dual-pixel views interpreted as pinhole projections of the same lens-formed virtual image.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: Original object/endpoints, lens and CL/CR centers, shared virtual image X-prime, sensor plane, left/right images and F dimension remain.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: X/X-prime, CL/CR, IL/IR and F labels are consistent. F is correctly defined as lens-to-sensor-plane distance according to Sec3.1, distinct from lens focal length f.

connections_and_direction.evidence: All eight original ray segments remain: four incident object-to-center segments and four refracted center-to-image segments. Corresponding red/blue rays intersect at the two ends of the shared inverted virtual image.

visual_encodings.evidence: Red CL→IL and blue CR→IR preserve source mapping. Real-world/object-space side, virtual-world side, image inversion and sensor-plane placement are unchanged qualitatively.

examples_and_data.evidence: This is a qualitative schematic with no empirical photograph or measured data. Source object geometry is redrawn illustratively while optical relations and ray counts are directly checked.

unsupported_additions.evidence: New mapping legend and X-prime/F definitions follow source caption and Sec3.1 pinhole observation. No measured distance, new lens law or scientific outcome is asserted.

complete_visible_content.evidence: All eight rays, center dots, real/virtual object endpoints, labels and F endpoints are visible. Distances remain schematic and should not be read as calibrated measurements.

remaining_limitations: Original illustrative scope remains. Qualitative optics is not calibrated geometry; empirical panels retain source resolution via documented resampling. Visual polish is judged separately.
